snippet.description:
Hello,
I’m Joanne Lee, the author of "Special Me" and "Weavy Bible Readers."
I’d like to introduce you to these books and explain how you can use them.
"Special Me" and "Weavy" are a series of Bible readers designed for young children. 

Special Me consists of 24 picture books that come with after-reading activities. 
They are simple pattern books, but they convey an integrated and profound message of Christianity telling who we are, what God has done for us, and what we need to do.
Weavy for elementary readers. The series contains 48 storybooks where children can come together feel united within the story, and hear the gospel with both their head and heart.
"Special Me" and "Weavy"?
Special Me and Weavy have various after-reading activities. 
Children will have a step-by-step discussion time for understanding analyzing and connecting. They also have language activities like sounds and letters, words, and sentences.

School Building Project
Using "Special Me" and "Weavy" as part of a book & reading program is a school-building project. And it’s a wonderful way to engage children from the community and bring them to church or school.

Teacher Training Program 
We train teachers online and offline. We help them to read aloud the Bible readers, lead the discussion, and conduct language activities.

YouTube & Website for program details, manuals, and materials 

We hope that this program will become a tool that brings children together from your community and helps them create today and tomorrow.
Thank you.

snippet.title: Special Me & Weavy Bible Readers I Joanne English I 조앤영어
snippet.description:
Hello,
I’m Joanne Lee, the author of "Special Me" and "Weavy Bible Readers."
I’d like to introduce you to these books and explain how you can use them.
"Special Me" and "Weavy" are a series of Bible readers designed for young children. 

Special Me consists of 24 picture books that come with after-reading activities. 
They are simple pattern books, but they convey an integrated and profound message of Christianity telling who we are, what God has done for us, and what we need to do.
Weavy for elementary readers. The series contains 48 storybooks where children can come together feel united within the story, and hear the gospel with both their head and heart.
"Special Me" and "Weavy"?
Special Me and Weavy have various after-reading activities. 
Children will have a step-by-step discussion time for understanding analyzing and connecting. They also have language activities like sounds and letters, words, and sentences.

School Building Project
Using "Special Me" and "Weavy" as part of a book & reading program is a school-building project. And it’s a wonderful way to engage children from the community and bring them to church or school.

Teacher Training Program 
We train teachers online and offline. We help them to read aloud the Bible readers, lead the discussion, and conduct language activities.

YouTube & Website for program details, manuals, and materials 

We hope that this program will become a tool that brings children together from your community and helps them create today and tomorrow.
Thank you.
